rules.title: corpus<->plane reconciliation adoption law (L1-L7)
rules.what: L1 direction corpus := plane verbatim (R2-a / run-010-m2 / run-011-m3 precedent generalized); L2 content-identity gate before ANY adoption - accepted proofs: known-family hunk census, cross-id counterpart confirmation, or eyeball sign-off recorded in dossier; failure quarantines to the cross-id queue; L3 benign-encoding class CLOSED (no edits either side; corpus keeps relative asset paths, URL pinning is a serving-layer concern); L4 cross-id class handled by a dedicated mapping-repair wave, never field-verbatim; L5 wave sequence: wave-A glue-spacing (62 fields / 61 parts), wave-B format families (43 fields / 43 parts); L6 drift-delta gate - post-wave full re-scan must reduce drift_fields by exactly the wave pin count with zero unrelated movement; L7 this census re-baselines the run-010-m2 drift disclosure
